decisions.text: Blaine is an overworld gym at the Craters, not the Nether.
Keep the Kanto chain; move the north-coast box inland near Peak Pond and Misty's box to Lake Viltri.
Disable the Cobbleverse-generated League copies (cobbleverse:kanto_league) in the End.
The critical path stays at ten settlements; everything added is off the route and optional.
The League stays at the head of the Rift, in the overworld.

method: Sites from tools/find_sites.py's largest-square search on the river-cut heightmap, with lake and river water and a 24-block setback excluded; legs are the full-resolution terrain-weighted A* routes in data/routes.json (tools/build_routes.py); off-path distances, nearest_leg and every recorded height and slope are re-measured by tools/measure_towns.py and checked by tools/validate_data.py. Tools produce candidates; these are proposals for a human to accept.

towns.for: The region's harbour: a fishing and boat-building port at a river mouth on the strait, where players charter boats for the Sunset isle across the water, the outer islands and the deep sea.
towns.why_here: Re-sited 2026-09-21. The first site, in the middle of the Sunset isle, was 576 to 884 blocks from the sea its harbour brief needs. No bay or inlet exists anywhere on the isle: its painted shore is smooth all the way round, with an 80-block shallow shelf. The best natural harbour in the south-west is this river mouth: a three-block river crossing a broad low coastal plain (63 to 66) into the strait, which is 250 to 400 blocks wide and sheltered by the isle to the south; its only long fetch is east, out of the strait's mouth. The isle stays in view across the water as the place the boats go. It is on the mainland now, 970 blocks off the path and 1,000 from Giovanni's town.

footprint.basis: authored round the river mouth and its quay, beach and piers; it takes in the river and the strait's edge on purpose

tiers.critical: the ten places the route requires: hometown, eight gym towns, the League
tiers.major: full off-path towns with their own identity and services; destinations
tiers.rest_stop: small, slightly off a long leg: Center, waystone, a couple of buildings, one NPC
tiers.outpost: one building or a small cluster; discovery without services

rules: The critical path is exactly the ten critical towns. Nothing else is on it, gates progression, or is needed to reach the next gym: every non-critical place has critical_path false, no gates, and no progression flag names it.
Rest stops sit 100-450 blocks off their leg; major towns and outposts at least 250 off the routed path.
Spacing: towns and rest stops at least 600 blocks apart; an outpost at least 300 from any settlement.

Waystones: flag-driven at the ten critical towns; discovery waystones only where re-finding the place is the hard part (islands, the underground city) or where convenience is the whole point (rest stops); none at major towns within a short walk of a gym waystone, and none at outposts.

critical_path_geometry.legs: full-resolution terrain-weighted A* between consecutive critical towns; required bridge crossings are mandatory waypoints; Victory Road is A* between the Rift arm, fork, trunk and apex waypoints
critical_path_geometry.victory_road: Giovanni's town to the Rift's south-west arm, up the arm to the fork, up the trunk to the apex, to the League

measurement_note: Every town's centre.ground_y, footprint.ground_y and footprint.slope_degrees are measured on the canonical heightmap 5b963567 (the rescale plus the three tools/press_pads.py pads) with find_sites' own slope (terrain.slope_degrees), at the recorded footprints, by tools/measure_towns.py; a town with built_ground is measured with that tool's surface laid over the heightmap. Sites were NOT re-searched: siting is an authored decision. A site that no longer meets its footprint basis carries site_review (tableland_stop, max slope 5.8 against under 5).
